description: Validate candidate inline task lines against THIS vault's dialect BEFORE writing them — the same parser the vault uses on load. Pass `line` (a single candidate line, e.g. `- [ ] Ship v2 📅 2026-07-15`) and/or `paths` (vault-relative files to lint whole; each is confined to the vault root). Reports one finding per offending line: an unrecognized status symbol, an emoji metadata token that this vault's dialect wouldn't read back as a field (a silently-dropped token), or a title left empty after metadata is stripped. Read-only. Use it to catch a mis-formatted line before add_task/update_task commits it.

line.description:
A single candidate inline task line to validate (e.g.
`- [ ] Ship v2 📅 2026-07-15`). The common case: check a line
before writing it.

paths.description:
Vault-relative file paths to lint whole. Each is confined to the
vault root; a path escaping the vault is refused.

name: lint_task
